output.explanation:
The central tree retains the seed's main responsibilities while shrinking from 113 to 77 lines (32%) and from 8655 to 5817 characters (33%). Five peripherals expand revision resolution, command consequences, spatial composition, saved-view lifecycles and transfers. Modular structure is expressed through component boundaries; call sequences show execution; ownership identifies retained state; data dependencies explain checkpoint materialization and reference remapping. Edges attach to the relevant concept lines. Positions use measured text bounds with gaps and no overlaps.

Source grounding: refs uses canvasHistory.ts; cmd uses mappingDocumentController.ts and mappingWorkspace.ts; grid uses lineGrid.ts, mappingGrid.ts and the controller; views uses canvasHistory.ts and canvasView.ts; move uses canvasTransfer.ts and canvasHistoryService.ts. Added details absent from the seed include operation-count limits, stale selection retention, section removal after patches, collision ordering, geometry limits, candidate-update identity checks and shared-content preservation during transfers.

Corrections and qualifications: the seed describes opening a CanvasView as always restoring a fresh checkpoint. canvasHistory.ts:278-288 shows that reopening the active view only stashes state, appending only when the supplied personal view differs; switching preserves the camera only when a viewport is supplied. Saved-view execution belongs to CanvasHistory, while canvasView.ts defines schemas and validation. canvasTransfer.ts:134-159 establishes that moving converts every source edge into a jump, including edges between remaining diagrams.

Only the supplied point, pinned source text and seed were used. Workspace publication is an ownership contract stated in the transfer source; its implementation is outside these inputs. Imported helper internals and browser/server integration were not independently verified.

Canvas Commands and History
|-- Editing boundary: controller -> history service -> CanvasHistory
|   |-- MappingDocumentController coordinates semantic edits and publishes snapshots
|   |   |-- Mounted live canvas: driver settles gestures and handles native undo/redo
|   |   `-- Headless proposals retain domain history through the same controller
|   `-- CanvasHistoryService owns history access and persistence
|       |-- openContext -> frozen object handle -> private WeakMap -> CanvasHistory
|       `-- Handle identity isolates viewers; runtime handles are never persisted
|-- Canonical state: CanvasHistoryRecord
|   |-- Navigation: baselineId + headId + past[] + future[]
|   |-- diagramRevisions: immutable revisions indexed by revision ID
|   |-- snapshots: StoredCanvasSnapshot indexed by checkpoint ID
|   |   |-- diagramBindings: diagram ID -> revision ID -> retained diagram revision
|   |   |-- document: composition with scene.root; no embedded diagram contents
|   |   |   |-- GridBox placements, edges, sections and revision-pinned jumps
|   |   |   `-- Presentations, contexts, alternatives, selections and reviews
|   |   |-- view: personal MappingCanvasState, separate from composition
|   |   |   `-- Camera, selection, diagram views, display and control surfaces
|   |   `-- parentId + nodeOrigins + optional transfer transactionId
|   |-- canvasViews: saved recordings, endpoints, ancestry and working copies
|   |   `-- Metadata stays outside checkpoint state restored by undo/apply
|   `-- document(checkpointId) materializes the rendering/transport read model
|       `-- Resolve bindings and logical edge refs; retain legacy stale endpoints
|-- Version-checked command path
|   |-- applyUpdate(expectedVersion, operations); transact delegates to it
|   |   |-- Settle gesture -> check version -> clone document/view -> stage in order
|   |   |-- Mismatch -> VERSION_CONFLICT; later operations see staged revisions
|   |   `-- Edit content, source context, composition, connections and presentation
|   |-- Reconcile before publishing the staged document and personal view
|   |   |-- Track node correspondence; rebase links; patches remap section lines
|   |   `-- Normalize views/selection/focus; prune orphan contexts and alternatives
|   |-- updateSnapshot(record=true) -> historyService.append -> CanvasHistory.append
|   |   |-- Validate composition, revisions and anchors before history mutation
|   |   |-- Retain bound revisions plus alternative/review/selection dependencies
|   |   `-- Store checkpoint -> old head to past -> new head -> clear future
|   `-- Publish snapshot -> increment version -> notify subscribers
|       |-- API returns projected nodes; native gesture saves one checkpoint
|       `-- Transient updateCanvas/layout may skip history and version advance
|-- Spatial composition: LineGridScene
|   |-- Contents table + GridBox tree; placements may share diagram content
|   |-- Containers own children at parent-relative cell positions
|   |-- resolveScene computes absolute bounds; collapsed boxes show summaries
|   |-- updateGridBox -> layoutScene anchors changes and pushes siblings right
|   `-- insertGridDiagram adds content/summary; composeScene validates and paints
|-- Saved CanvasViews
|   |-- create/save pin named endpoints; open stashes/resumes working copies
|   |   `-- Switching appends a checkpoint and preserves camera; same-view open stashes
|   |-- dirty compares composition, bindings and view minus viewport/selection
|   |-- fork opens one child; alternatives create independent children without switching
|   |   `-- keep saves child and archives sibling subtrees; discard archives target subtree
|   |-- Generation pins candidate state and returns isolated history for work
|   |   `-- Finished proposals advance candidate endpoints without moving live head
|   |-- start/stop record checkpoint IDs; cancel removes recording metadata
|   |-- Comparison reads pinned endpoints; promote-diffs adds diagram alternatives
|   `-- apply restores saved endpoint as a fresh checkpoint without transfer linkage
|-- Navigation and workspace transfers
|   |-- Local undo/redo validates target and exchanges head with past/future
|   |   `-- Restore composition and personal view; CanvasViews metadata stays outside
|   |-- reset appends baseline state; fork creates context/baseline with empty stacks
|   `-- prepareCanvasTransfer works on isolated source/destination histories
|       |-- Require distinct canvases and nonempty, unique diagram-box selection
|       |-- Preserve relative placement; remap conflicting identities and links
|       |-- Copy: fresh identities, source unchanged, edges only within selection
|       |-- Move: remove placements; convert all source edges into routed jumps
|       |-- Append destination; move also appends source; return linked transaction
|       `-- Workspace publishes; undo/redo requires both expected canvas boundaries
|           `-- Move navigates both histories; copy navigates destination only
`-- Persistence and validation
    |-- persistenceChanges(since): header/navigation + changed snapshots/revisions
    |   `-- Sequence cursor and CanvasCheckpointEncoder support incremental storage
    |-- export(true): real head + referenced revisions + missing-parent boundaries
    |   `-- Saved views or active recording force full export of checkpoint graphs
    |-- adopt(proposed): validate, retain revision IDs, publish head as one checkpoint
    |   `-- Conflicting content under an existing immutable revision ID is rejected
    `-- Validate references, revision parents, bindings, contexts and canonical anchors
        |-- Checkpoints cannot embed diagrams; linked transfers require workspace undo
        `-- Full or current-only validation; other checkpoints validate when accessed

Checkpoint resolution and retention
|-- Materialize document(checkpointId)
|   |-- Checkpoint diagramBindings -> retained revision.diagram
|   |-- Add scene.contents to stored scene.root
|   `-- Clone result; deep-freeze each resolved diagram
|-- Resolve an edge's logical node reference
|   |-- displayNodeId -> owning GridBox -> contentId
|   |-- contentId -> checkpoint binding -> revision
|   `-- Reverse revision.nodeRefs -> node ID + content revision ID
|-- encodeAnchor stores logical refs without revisionId
|   |-- Box targets remain box targets
|   `-- Unresolved legacy endpoint -> side table keyed by edge/end
|       `-- Decode returns that saved stale endpoint unchanged
|-- nodeOrigins tracks identity across checkpoint edits
|   |-- Initial nodes map to themselves
|   `-- Later nodes inherit known origins through correspondence
|-- checkpointRevisionIds includes more than visible bindings
|   |-- Alternative and review revision dependencies
|   `-- Selection revisionId, baseRevisionId and contextRevisionId
|-- export(true), when no saved views or recording
|   |-- Keep real head ID; remove checkpoint parent; empty undo stacks
|   `-- Missing revision parents -> revisionBoundary parent-to-diagram map
`-- adopt preserves the revision table object used by the resolver
    `-- Add revisions to that table; publish one new checkpoint

Command checks and staged consequences
|-- applyUpdate / transact
|   |-- Driver settles first; then expectedVersion must match
|   |-- Clear pending node correspondence before and after API batch
|   `-- 1-100 operations; native batch with editorCanvas allows 10000
|-- Each operation reads the evolving cloned document
|   |-- prepareDiagramEdit uses that content's staged revisionId
|   |-- diagram-context-set checks revision, diagram identity and fingerprint
|   |-- diagram-revision-apply checks expected revision before receiving it
|   `-- edge-update validates changed endpoints; unchanged gets special flag
|-- patchDiagram maps node IDs and line numbers
|   |-- Reanchor matching current edges and active jump spans
|   |-- Remap per-instance collapsed nodes for matching content revision
|   `-- Remap section endpoints; drop section if either line disappears
|-- Selection ownership during updateSnapshot
|   |-- Whole-instance membership disappears with deleted placement
|   |-- Captured regions remain available as stale snapshots
|   `-- Focus requires region, matching content ID and identical source ASCII
|-- Geometry consequences
|   |-- Native grid moves defer layout until batch end
|   `-- Changed scene/diagram views invalidate measured endpoint bounds
`-- Publication follows reconciliation and history append
    |-- New snapshot invalidates node cache by object identity
    `-- API adds cloned node registry; native path uses snapshot

Grid geometry and placement ownership
|-- GridBox owns placement; contents table owns referenced diagrams
|   |-- duplicate-instance reuses contentId and copies instance view
|   `-- insertGridDiagram creates a summary and expands parent container
|-- resolveScene measures without mutating
|   |-- Absolute origin = parent origin + local position
|   |-- Expanded size covers children, content and minimumSize
|   `-- Collapsed box requires summary; ignores minimumSize and children
|-- layoutScene settles each expanded container
|   |-- Changed descendant's sibling subtree is placed first
|   |-- Others sort by column, row, then original array index
|   |-- Settled bounds become obstacles; collisions shift only right
|   `-- composeScene checks resulting bounds and sibling overlap
|-- Geometry constraints
|   |-- Coordinates/extents: integers from 0 through 20000
|   |-- Composed rectangle: at most 4000000 cells
|   `-- Content measurement: printable ASCII and LF only
`-- Read operations depend on resolved bounds
    |-- hitTest: children first, then containing box; return local cells
    |-- Right/bottom boundaries are exclusive
    `-- projectMapping converts 1-based source spans to scene cells

Saved views and isolated candidate work
|-- Ownership: CanvasHistory implements commands; canvasView defines schema
|   `-- Saved metadata and workingCopies pin checkpoint IDs outside undo state
|-- openCanvasView
|   |-- Same active view: stash only; append only if supplied view changed
|   `-- Different view: working copy preferred over saved final checkpoint
|       |-- Validate target -> stash outgoing state -> clone target checkpoint
|       `-- Remove transfer link; copy supplied viewport when available
|-- Branch lifecycle
|   |-- alternatives: 1-10 unique names; children share pinned saved start
|   |-- fork: create one child and open it
|   |-- keep archives other group members and their descendants
|   |-- discard archives target subtree; leave it if currently active
|   `-- delete requires a leaf; saved children prevent deletion
|-- startGeneration: 1-8 candidates with distinct IDs
|   |-- Normal path exports parent's saved endpoint, not live head
|   |-- Remove CanvasViews and trim to that endpoint's revision dependencies
|   `-- Optional pinned history supports replay even without original parent
|       `-- Validate imported state and reject immutable-ID conflicts
|-- updateGeneration
|   |-- Match view, runId and chatId; reject archived target
|   |-- Settled status accepts identical repeat; rejects changed update
|   `-- Proposed history requires status finished and passes validation
|       |-- Import revisions; clone proposal head without transactionId
|       `-- Advance candidate endpoint; live head and undo stacks stay put
`-- Mutation guards
    |-- Recording blocks create/open/fork/save/alternatives/keep/discard
    `-- Running target blocks edits; keep/discard/delete also guard related runs

Transfer preparation and paired navigation
|-- Prepare isolated histories; workspace owns publication
|   |-- Select diagram placements; measure with containers expanded
|   `-- Subtract selected minimum column/row to preserve relative positions
|-- Identity and reference mapping
|   |-- Copy creates fresh box/content IDs; move reuses unless conflicting
|   |-- One content-ID map preserves sharing among selected instances
|   |-- Copy sections; rebase presentation highlights and local jump spans
|   `-- Retarget jump only if source alias and selected target both match
|-- Copy connections
|   `-- Both endpoints must be selected; remap anchors and mint edge ID
|-- Move connections
|   |-- Iterate EVERY source edge, including edges between remaining diagrams
|   |-- Convert each to a jump; partition by whether source placement moves
|   |-- Route target to source/destination canvas; source edge list becomes empty
|   `-- Remaining diagram-local links also follow moved targets
|-- Merge destination
|   |-- Ask placeTransferredGroup for placement
|   |-- Append under expanded container or wrap existing root in new container
|   `-- Keep existing destination edges; merge transferred sections and jumps
|-- Link transaction after destination append
|   |-- Record source/destination before and after checkpoint IDs
|   `-- Link destination checkpoint; link source checkpoint only for move
`-- prepareTransferNavigation
    |-- Check both boundaries even for copy; reject discarded/wrong applied state
    |-- Move navigates both; copy navigates destination; applied becomes redo
    `-- Default service blocks local navigation of linked checkpoints
